response.query: Research on MOMA-AC: a preference-driven actor-critic framework for continuous multi-objective multi-agent RL combining multi-headed actors, centralized critic, preference conditioning, and instantiations with TD3/DDPG, focusing on Pareto front representation, scalarizations, twin critics, and reproducibility in multi-agent control.
response.answer: MOMA-AC is a preference-driven actor-critic framework for continuous multi-objective multi-agent reinforcement learning, utilizing multi-headed actors, a centralized critic, and preference conditioning. It employs TD3/DDPG instantiations and focuses on Pareto front representation and twin critics for reproducibility.

results.title: [PDF] Actor-Attention-Critic for Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning - arXiv
results.content: Actor-Attention-Critic for Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning Shariq Iqbal 1 Fei Sha 1 2 Abstract Reinforcement learning in multi-agent scenar-ios is important for real-world applications but presents challenges beyond those seen in single-agent settings. We present an actor-critic algo-rithm that trains decentralized policies in multi-agent settings, using centrally computed crit-ics that share an attention mechanism which se-lects relevant information for each agent at every timestep. This attention mechanism enables more effective and scalable learning in complex multi-agent environments, when compared to recent approaches. Our approach is applicable not only to cooperative settings with shared rewards, but also individualized reward settings, including ad-versarial settings, as well as settings that do not provide global states, and it makes no assump-tions about the action spaces of the agents. In order to learn effectively in multi-agent environments, agents must not only learn the dynamics of their environment, but also those of the other learning agents present.

results.title: Multi-agent Natural Actor-critic Reinforcement Learning Algorithms
results.content: We propose three fully decentralized multi-agent natural actor-critic (MAN) algorithms in this work. The objective is to collectively find a joint policy.
